data.name: Yahyah
data.long_meaning: Means 'given by Allah' in Arabic. This name is mentioned in the Quran and belongs to Prophet Yahya (John the Baptist) in Islam.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith and purity. Prophet Yahya is known as a righteous and pious prophet who devoted his life to spreading the word of Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents harmony, balance, and love. People with a 6 life path number are compassionate, caring, and nurturing.

in_arabic.name: يحيى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم يحيى مشتق من الفعل حيّا، ويعني من يمنح الحياة والنماء، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كاسم للنبي يحيى بن زكريا عليه السلام، ويحمل الاسم دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالحياة والموت والبعث

in_urdu.name: یحییٰ
in_urdu.meaning: زندگی دینے والا، نشونما پانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام یحییٰ عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے زندگی دینے والا یا نشونما پانے والا، یہ نام اہل سنت وجماعت کے نبی یحییٰ بن زکریا رضی اللہ عنہ کے نام سے منسوب ہے، جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: यहया
in_hindi.meaning: जीवन देने वाला, वृद्धि करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम यहया अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जीवन देने वाला या वृद्धि करने वाला, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह पैगंबर यहया बिन ज़कारिया का नाम है

in_pashto.name: یحیی
in_pashto.meaning: د ژوند ورکوونکی، د ودې کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د یحیی نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ژوند ورکوونکی یا د ودې کوونکی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د پېغمبر یحیی بن زکریا لپاره کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Yahyah
in_english.meaning: Living, reviving, or God will save
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yahyah originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-y-y' which means 'to live' or 'to revive', it is associated with John the Baptist in Islamic tradition, signifying one who brings life or God will save

data.cultural_impact: Prophet Yahyah is considered an important figure in Islamic history and is revered by Muslims worldwide. He is known as the last prophet before the advent of Prophet Isa (Jesus). Yahyah is usually depicted as living in the desert, wearing coarse hair and a leather belt, and subsisting on locusts and honey. He is often symbolized as a hermit, reminding Muslims of the importance of inner purity and asceticism.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, Prophet Yahyah was a messenger of God, sent to guide the people towards the right path. He was known for his honesty, bravery, and devotion to Allah. By bearing the name Yahyah, Muslims are reminded of this divine legacy and expected to live up to its ethical and spiritual values. The name also signifies the idea of being 'given by Allah', emphasizing human dependency on Divine Grace and Remembrance.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Yahyah ibn Zakariyya is known as the father of Prophet Yahya (John the Baptist) in Islamic tradition. He was born to the priestly family of Zakariyya in Jerusalem during the time of the Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his son Isma'il (Ishmael).

Prophet Yahya (John the Baptist) was a prominent figure in the religious scene of the Arabian Peninsula before the advent of Islam. He is believed to have been born to Zakariyya in the wilderness of Palestine around 5 BCE, and he preached the message of repentance and baptism for the forgiveness of sins.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yahyah, which means 'gracious' or 'handsome' in Arabic, is a popular choice for babies in the Muslim community and beyond. It is often searched for under Islamic names, modern Arabic names, and baby names on platforms such as Pinterest, Instagram, and Facebook. Parents may choose this name due to its meaning, its connection to Islamic tradition, or simply because they find it beautiful. The name Yahyah is also popular in various forms, such as Yahya, Ya'ya, or Yahiya, reflecting the diversity of Arabic language and culture.
